text:
maggie: Heads-up — infra telemetry flagged small perf regressions on runtime-2.16 with SDK 3.4 when serving quantized llama-family models. Can we coordinate a short pin/holdback while we validate? :eyes:

sam: Noted. Is this specific to a kernel path or the new batching heuristic?

olivia: From initial triage, looks like kv-cache warmup stalls on longseq workloads after the SDK change (3.4). CPU offload path hits a rare branch. Repro in staging with a 16k seq test.

maggie: Okay. Suggestion: open a temporary pin for hosted and dedicated for the next 2h window to avoid user impact while we run a focused canary. deploy-bot, can you stage a pin and announce?

deploy-bot: /pin runtime runtime-2.15 -> runtime-2.16? Clarify target.

maggie: Sorry, pin runtime to 2.15 (i.e., hold back the 2.16 rollout). Apply to: hosted-us, hosted-eu, dedicated-smallpool. Window: immediate, expire in 2h unless someone extends. Reason: SDK 3.4 kv-cache cold path regression.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Executing pin: `/deploy pin --target=runtime --version=2.15 --scope=hosted-us,hosted-eu,dedicated-smallpool --expires=2h --by=maggie --note="hold for SDK 3.4 kv-cache regressions"`

deploy-bot: Pin applied ✅. Observability link: https://console.redwood/shards/pin/8523456789

kevin: I kicked off a reduced-canary run on dedicated-canary with both SDK 3.4 and SDK 3.3 to diff token-level latency and kv-stalls. Early numbers show 3.4 p50 +11ms and a tiny increase in stall counts. Uploading logs.

olivia: Can you paste the minimal repro command? I'll try replicate locally.

kevin: Sure — `python tools/bench_longseq.py --model llama-q --seq 16000 --sdk 3.4 --warmup 50 --iters 30`

sam: If we confirm regressions, what's our rollback path? Do we revert SDK in runtime or unpin and roll runtime back to 2.15? Need decision tree.

maggie: Plan A: if minimal fix exists in SDK (tiny guard), ship a one-line SDK patch and unpin after verification. Plan B: if root cause requires longer work, keep pin and schedule a staged rollback of runtime jobs on affected pools to 2.15 with QA signoff.

sre-oncall: I'll add a temporary routing rule to divert longseq heavy traffic away from canary pools to reduce noisy neighbor risk. Also will raise an alert threshold for kv-stalls so we can auto-notify if counts spike.

olivia: I found a promising protective check — we can short-circuit the offload branch when observed kv-cache miss > 3 for a request. If tests pass we could cut an SDK 3.4.1 patch.

maggie: Good. Let's aim for 1 hour triage. If we don't have a safe patch by then, we keep the pin and call for runtime rollback. Everyone ok with that SLA?

sam: 👍

kevin: 👍 running extended tests now, will post results in 20m.

deploy-bot: Reminder: pin expires in 2h (852346? — system). Use `/deploy extend-pin 8523456789 --delta=1h` to request more time.

maggie: Thanks — I'll update release notes and customer ops once we decide.

olivia: Posting quick diff report in #eng-releases shortly with raw traces and flamegraphs.

maggie: Appreciate it. If anyone discovers an unrelated impact, call for immediate rollback. Otherwise we'll reconvene here in 60m. :thumbsup:
